summary: The notebook currently has two featured notes: a foundational gradient-descent course note and a structured reading of the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One course note covering gradient descent, loss landscapes, learning-rate intuition, and a worked quadratic example.
areas.gap: The ml-foundations course has only its first note so far; subsequent topics like momentum and Adam are implied but not yet written.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A detailed reading of 'Attention Is All You Need' covering self-attention, multi-head attention, and WMT 2014 results.
areas.gap: Follow-up topics like sub-quadratic attention, positional encoding variants, and training-stability recipes are listed as improvements but have no notes yet.
